titleText: BirdLife calls for end to finch trapping following second EU Commission warning
mainText: From The Malta Independent: BirdLife calls for end to finch trapping following second EU Commission warning. BirdLife Malta has called on the government to withdraw its finch trapping derogation after the European Commission issued a second warning to Malta over its continued authorisation of the practice under the guise of scientific research.

titleText: Malta MEP calls out Europe's reluctance to condemn Israel 'genocide'
mainText: From Times of Malta: Malta MEP calls out Europe's reluctance to condemn Israel 'genocide'. 'We are afraid of telling it as it really is,' Daniel Attard tells Strasbourg during EP debate on Gaza

titleText: Mohammed Ali, 10, killed at home in Sudan while getting ready for school
mainText: From Times of Malta: Mohammed Ali, 10, killed at home in Sudan while getting ready for school. 'Any parent in Malta who got their child ready for school this morning will understand what this family has lost': Karl Schembri, NRC humanitarian

titleText: Another mobile phone found in prisoner's possession during raid at Corradino prison, Minister says
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Another mobile phone found in prisoner's possession during raid at Corradino prison, Minister says. Another mobile phone was found in the possession of an inmate during a raid on his cell at the Corradino Correctional Facility on Tuesday evening, Home Affairs Minister Glenn Bedingfield said.

titleText: Another mobile phone discovered in prison cell during night raid
mainText: From MaltaToday: Another mobile phone discovered in prison cell during night raid. Another mobile phone has been found in an inmate’s cell in the Corradino Correctional Facility (CCF). In a Facebook post on Tuesday night, Home Affairs Minister Glenn Bedingfield said “another phone” was found during a raid in a prison cell.
